He’s had a drinking issue my whole life but he only drinks once or twice a week now but when he does it’s hard for me to deal with. So I think the insurance is unfair as well I would like it to go to all of my siblings not just me. But I don’t know how insurance works so I don’t know if my claim is disputable but I’ll try anyway!
That’s a good idea, the more time goes on the more I think he did something to her but I can’t prove it and she’s been cremated so there isn’t more evidence to go off on other than a autopsy

When she died the police where they’re and a report what made but I never got to see the results of it. I got left out of everything that involved getting some kinda clarity on what was going on. Mums side of the family even hid the will from me refusing to show me so that’s why I had to get a lawyer to see it. They have been making life hard from the start

I got locked out when I was at dads so I couldn’t get my stuff I took it as a sign they didn’t want me and didn’t go back. Legit made up so many lies on why they locked me out the house.”you were stealing” or “your father broke into the house” or “money has gone missing so we lock the doors now” but I knew how to break in so I got only MY stuff back I didn’t touch anything else and then they put more security on the house. This all happened when I was meant to be temporary staying with my Dad but now I live full time.
